segments.normalizedSource: ``` from pathlib import Path import mlx.data as dx def files_and_classes(root: Path): """Load the files and classes from an image dataset that contains one folder per class.""" images = list(root.rglob("*.jpg")) categories = [p.relative_to(root).parent.name for p in images] category_set = set(categories) category_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(sorted(category_set))} return [ { "image": str(p.relative_to(root)).encode("ascii"), "category": c, "label": category_map[c] } for c, p in zip(categories, images) ] dset = dx.buffer_from_vector(files_and_classes(Path("path/to/dataset))) # We can now apply transformations to the dataset ```

```
# We can define the rest of the processing pipeline using streams.
# 1. First shuffle the buffer
# 2. Make a stream
# 3. Batch and then prefetch
dset = (
    dset
    .shuffle()
    .to_stream()  # <-- making a stream from the shuffled buffer
    .batch(32)
    .prefetch(8, 4)  # <-- prefetch 8 batches using 4 threads
)

# Now we can iterate over dset
sample = next(dset)
```
